release_read.basis: Q3 adj EPS $1.03 vs ~$0.89 street and $0.85 guide with gross margin +200bp is a clear beat on a stock with 18.6% short interest, but FY sales guide was cut ($2.91-2.93B vs 2-3% growth before) and the FY EPS range was only maintained, so the Q3 beat implies a softer Q4 ($1.37-1.55) and the CFO's tariff 'upside' did not reach the guide.

key_line.detail: Thesis was the CFO's flagged tariff upside to the earnings outlook. FY adj EPS kept at a high-single to low-double-digit decline vs $3.47 ($3.05-3.23) and adj op income at LSD-MSD growth: unchanged despite a ~$0.18 Q3 beat vs guide, so Q4 implied lower ($1.37-1.55 vs $1.90 LY, 14-week quarter). Net sales guide moderated to $2.91-2.93B from +2-3%. $132m IEEPA refund recovered, excluded from adjusted.

guidance.detail: Sales outlook lowered (~+0.4-1.1% vs +2-3% prior); EPS and op income ranges maintained, i.e. Q3 beat not passed through.

call.detail: Call at 08:30 ET, already held; content not reviewed in the time available. A leadership-structure change was announced in a separate release.

public_reaction.summary: Only one headline found (getmidas, Turkish) framing the quarter as a beat on adjusted operating profit (+54%). No analyst actions found in the time available.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 32.33, -3.1% vs prev close 33.38 (the stock rose into yesterday's close after the 13:30 entry at 32.61, so the position is about -1% now). Pre-market stale: 10 prints, 2 in the last 30m, last 08:49, just after the call began. Market weak (SPY -1.0%, QQQ -2.6%, IWM -0.5%), which explains part of it. Against a +3% release read this is an undershoot of ~6 points, but on a thin tape the sales-guide cut may be what the market is reading.

thesis_check.note: Margin and EPS beat confirm the setup; the tariff upside did not reach the full-year guide and the sales outlook was cut.

expected.open_lag_note: Stale, thin pre-market (last print 08:49, 2 prints in 30 minutes) makes the open uncertain; a clear EPS and margin beat against a negative gap on a heavily shorted stock and a weak tape argues for some recovery toward the prior close in the first half hour.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers waren beter dan verwacht (winst per aandeel $1,03 tegen circa $0,89, hogere marge), maar de omzetverwachting voor het jaar is verlaagd en de voorbeurs staat ruim 3% lager, op weinig handel. De positie staat licht in het verlies; we verwachten dat een deel van die daling in het eerste halfuur wordt goedgemaakt en verkopen om 10:00 in plaats van om 13:00.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurs voor 09:30 op veel handel verder zakt richting $31,76 of lager, dan liever direct bij de opening verkopen.
